title: Design: turning Part Sale pricing on and off
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with Separate Part Sale pricing off.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name.
  3. Click the Part Sale Matrix tab.
  4. Switch Separate Part Sale pricing on.
  5. Switch Separate Part Sale pricing off.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The switch is off.

Step 4:

  • The switch turns blue and reads On; a grid with Edit and the simulator appear.
  • A message at the bottom right reads "Separate Part Sale pricing on" with "It starts as a copy of the work order prices. Click Edit to change them.", as in picture 3.18.

Step 5:

  • A dialog titled "Turn Off Part Sale Pricing?" opens.
  • Cancel is white and Turn Off red, as in picture 3.20.
